description: This bar chart, titled “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis,” compares the accuracy of three sentiment analysis methods—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 on a linear scale, with gridlines at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis presents the two tweet categories. For each category, three bars are displayed side-by-side: a white bar with no fill for TEXTBLOB, a gray bar with diagonal stripes for VADER, and a solid green bar for ChatGPT. In the “Emoji Tweets” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.3 for TEXTBLOB, 0.4 for VADER, and 0.6 for ChatGPT. In the “Overall Tweet” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.4 for TEXTBLOB, 0.4 for VADER, and 0.6 for ChatGPT. The bars are grouped by tweet category, and the legend in the lower right corner identifies each method by its corresponding bar color and pattern. The chart does not show any sorting of bars by height, and no bars are visually emphasized with special formatting.
